title: Three Pieces
identity: Donemus public preview identifies Frédéric Devreese's Three Pieces (2002) for alto saxophone and piano, D14208, approximately ten minutes. The score contents list Country dance, Melody, and French can-can. A separate composer worklist also identifies a flute-or-alto version; this inspected edition labels alto saxophone.

evidence.claim: Donemus score cover and information page identify Three Pieces (2002), alto saxophone and piano, D14208, approx. ten minutes, with movement titles and starting pages.

The inspected first movement is in 2/4, marked Allegro moderato quarter=120; the saxophone rests at the opening while piano sustains repeated harmonies, then saxophone enters with a fast beamed figure.
Composer worklist also lists a flute or alto saxophone version.
evidence.source_name: The Living Composers Project composer worklist

score_observations.observation: Country dance begins in 2/4 at Allegro moderato, quarter=120. The saxophone rests while piano presents sustained repeated harmonies, then enters with a quick beamed figure; dynamics rise from mf to f in the preview.

review_focus: Inference: the opening places a delayed saxophone entrance over sustained piano harmony, followed by a fast saxophone figure; verify contrasting movement writing in the full score.
collection_flag: Published saxophone/piano version of three short pieces; composer worklist indicates flute alternative as well.

score_links.description: Donemus public preview, title/instrumentation/duration and first movement notation inspected.

gaps: Only the first movement's opening page was inspected; notation for Melody and French can-can and any performance recording remain unverified.
